run_rule: TWO calls, in this order, each only after the CI exec cell of FORM-14542-2.md is green and acp names this file's sha12. DRY: the FORM-325-14486-7 REAL window (START_MS 1795416503000, END_MS 1795420103000; END - START = 3600000). REAL: the 24 h window of FORM-14542-1 (START_MS 1795416503000, END_MS 1795502903000; END - START = 86400000), at or after END + 35 min. pm substitutes ONLY the tokens ${START_MS} and ${END_MS} (epoch ms integers), every occurrence, and sends `body` as written. start/end are JSON NUMBERS (no quotes): this file is a template and is valid JSON only after the fill. The statement gates itself (cost_gate on system.clusters + system.parts, STOP-COST-GATE). An error, a timeout or a DRY WANT miss = STOP, no re-run, no REAL.
